svg.title: From user input to an isolated task and a verified result
svg.desc: Illustrative flexible-task path. Host-owned Telegram or HTTP entrypoints verify identity and build a trusted request. Harness Bridge uses OpenShell Docker to run existing DSH with an optional Skill and configured tools. Owned cleanup precedes structured results; the host separately authorizes delivery. Flow groups are stages, not deployment trust boundaries. No warm pool is implemented.
